Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

You will join our global Web3 growth and ecosystem team and support the global growth and ecosystem development of broader Web3 initiatives.

This is a global role working closely with cross-functional teams across multiple markets and regions to identify opportunities.

Responsibilities will be carried out in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

Role Overview

This is a global Web3 growth and ecosystem role, based in Hong Kong and operating across markets. We are looking for a globally minded operations professional who is deeply involved in the on-chain ecosystem, understands diverse on-chain user communities, and can independently plan and execute campaigns across regions.

You will work around X Layer and OKX Wallet to connect ecosystem projects, communities, and users worldwide; bring high-quality applications to real users; and turn campaign participation into sustained on-chain usage and ecosystem growth.

This focuses respectively on public blockchain ecosystem partnerships and operations and global Wallet user growth and campaign operations. Both require strong ecosystem knowledge, cross-market user insight, and end-to-end campaign execution capabilities.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Ecosystem Research and Opportunity Identification: Continuously track leading public blockchains and sectors such as DeFi, on-chain trading, and consumer applications across global markets. Identify projects with product value, an established user base, and growth potential, and develop actionable partnership and operational plans.

•

Ecosystem Partnerships and Development: Build and maintain relationships with project teams, communities, and ecosystem partners across regions. Drive globally scalable co-marketing campaigns, application promotion, and user education, while continuously tracking post-launch activity and growth.

•

Global User Insights and Operations: Engage deeply with on-chain user communities across markets to understand the motivations, decision-making habits, and barriers faced by different user segments. Establish user segmentation and feedback mechanisms, and optimise the conversion journey from first-time experience to ongoing usage.

•

Campaign Planning and Execution: Independently lead global and regional ecosystem co-marketing campaigns, on-chain quests, trading campaigns, community incentive programs, AMAs, and online/offline events. Own target-setting, campaign mechanics, budget planning, resource coordination, launch execution, and post-campaign analysis.

•

Growth and Data Analysis: Define metrics around qualified new users, first on-chain interactions, activity, retention, and partner-project growth. Evaluate performance using on-chain and product data, and continuously optimize participation requirements, incentive mechanisms, and operational investment.

•

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Data, and regional teams to turn user feedback into product and operational improvements, ensuring a seamless connection between campaigns and the product experience.

What We Look For In You

•

Experience in Web3 ecosystem operations, user growth, community operations, or campaign operations. Able to provide complete case studies of projects personally led, with verifiable results.

•

Long-term, hands-on participation in the on-chain ecosystem. Proficient in using wallets, DEXs, cross-chain bridges, and mainstream DApps; understands core concepts such as token approvals, gas fees, slippage, and liquidity; and can independently conduct product-experience and user-journey analysis.

•

Familiarity with on-chain users and their communities. Understands behavioral differences among trading-focused, DeFi-focused, and task-driven users, and can distinguish short-term, incentive-driven participation from needs that support sustained usage.

•

Understanding of public blockchain ecosystem-building dynamics, including project onboarding, application distribution, user acquisition, liquidity, and communities. Able to design partnership proposals that create value for both project teams and users.

•

Proven experience independently planning and executing campaigns. Able to clearly articulate campaign objectives, target audience, mechanics, budget, execution process, and final outcomes, and propose improvements based on post-campaign reviews.

•

Strong data mindset, with the ability to analyze operational conversion funnels, user retention, and campaign costs. Accountable for genuine user growth and business outcomes.

•

Strong communication, project-management, and execution skills; able to drive projects in a fast-paced, globally distributed, cross-functional environment. Professional English communication and copywriting skills are required to work effectively with international projects, communities, and internal stakeholders. Additional language capabilities and experience operating across multiple markets are advantageous.

Preferred Global Experience

•

Deep involvement in on-chain ecosystems such as RWA and Meme, with an understanding of user personas, community culture, asset issuance, and trading mechanics across different sectors. Relevant project operations or growth experience is preferred.

•

Ongoing attention to and hands-on experience with emerging protocols such as Tapeout. Able to analyze product mechanics, user participation journeys, and growth opportunities, and translate these into concrete partnership or campaign proposals.

•

Experience in Meme community operations, trend-based campaign planning, or on-chain trading campaigns. Able to manage communication timing and drive community participation and user conversion.

•

Experience in user education, ecosystem partnerships, or campaign planning for RWA projects. Able to translate complex product mechanisms into clear, easy-to-understand content and participation flows.

•

An active global network of on-chain users, project teams, trading communities, or content creators, with the ability to independently drive cross-market partnerships and produce verifiable growth results.

•

Demonstrated success in converting early momentum around emerging sectors or protocols into Wallet usage, on-chain interactions, and sustained retention.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

Disclaimer: Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

The Pepperstone story started in 2010. We know what it’s like to trade the world’s markets. Our team describes us as a place for the curious and the driven, and we like to do things a little differently; as a transformative global fintech, we’re digital, nimble, connected, and united in our vision to create a better way to trade.
We thrive on progress – for our clients and for ourselves. Our organisational culture is ever-evolving, vibrant, diverse, global, and results-focused. You’ll find our 550+ team currently across 11 locations and 9 time zones.

The Role
The Trading Platform Architect is an elite individual contributor role responsible for the long-term technical vision, scalability, and performance of Pepperstone’s core trading ecosystems and liquidity routing infrastructure. This role sits above day-to-day operations to spearhead our largest, highest-stakes infrastructure projects, such as multi-asset bridging configurations, global ultra-low latency server network designs, and complex LP integrations. You will act as the primary technical authority on platform architecture, ensuring our ecosystem is robust, secure, and built for massive volume growth, with no direct reports or line-management responsibilities.
Your key responsibilities will include:
• Design and architect the global deployment, topology, and failover logic of MT4, MT5, cTrader, and TradingView server environments
• Own the lifecycle of major infrastructure projects, including bridge migrations, cross-region server deployments, and new technology vendor integrations
• Optimize and scale liquidity bridging infrastructure (OneZero, PrimeXM) and advanced aggregation engines to minimize execution latency and slippage
• Engineer robust FIX API connectivity and custom routing rules to maximize execution quality across multiple Liquidity Providers (LPs)
• Conduct deep-dive technical diagnostics on complex structural platform anomalies, infrastructure bottlenecks, and feed pricing logic
• Collaborate as a strategic technical advisor with internal IT, DevOps, Trading Operations, and external institutional technology partners
• Ensure architectural compliance with global financial regulations and strict institutional security standards

About you
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Financial Engineering, or a highly related technical discipline.
• 5 to 10 years of hands-on experience specifically within the FX/CFD broker or institutional trading landscape.
• Mastery of trading platform server backends, with expert-level configuration knowledge of MT4, MT5, and cTrader.
• Expert knowledge of Liquidity Bridge Providers, specifically advanced configuration and aggregation logic in OneZero Hub and PrimeXM XCore.
• Deep understanding of the FIX protocol (FIX 4.2 / 4.4) and low-latency network infrastructure engineering.
• Proficiency in database management and analytics, specifically writing advanced SQL queries for trade data and server log analysis.
• Proven track record of independently delivery massive, complex fintech infrastructure projects from conception to completion

Why you will enjoy working with us
• Competitive salary structure including company bonus scheme
• Flexible and hybrid working
• Remote working option - work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year
• Company paid sick leave annually
• Paid vacation leave
• 3 paid volunteering days per year & Workplace Giving Program
• Comprehensive medical insurance with coverage for your healthcare needs
• Pension fund
• Employee referral bonuses for referring top talent to the company
• Ongoing personal development & learning opportunities
• Periodic recognition and reward programs for outstanding performance and achievements
• Frequent events and celebrations
• Genuinely collaborative and friendly culture
• Employee Assistance Program & Wellbeing Initiatives

More about Pepperstone
We’re a regulated online Forex and CFD trading platform. With the scale of a global fintech and the agility of a start-up, we arm our clients with everything they need to take on the global markets with confidence. You will be part of a wider passionate and friendly team, and whilst things may not always go to plan, we learn quickly and move forward with impact. Job Description
As part of its ongoing organisational evolution, Swissquote is creating a new department, the Client Lifecycle Integrity (CLI) Department. Acting as a 1.5 line of defence and independent from the Front Office, the CLI brings together key activities supporting the integrity-related management of private client relationships throughout their lifecycle, from onboarding and periodic reviews to AML transaction monitoring.
In this context, the Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will play a key leadership role in shaping and implementing the new organisation. As a member of Senior Management and Director, the role is responsible for defining the CLI’s strategic direction, establishing an effective and forward-looking operating model, driving a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence and ensuring the successful integration and performance of its different activities, in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and internal policies. The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity shall in particular have a strong focus on technology enablement, AI-driven optimisation and operational scalability, with a strong client-centric and data-driven approach.
The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will act as a senior partner to the Executive Management and work closely with the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department as well as technology functions to continuously enhance the Bank’s integrity-related client lifecycle framework.

Key responsibilities:
1. Leadership, Governance & Stakeholder Management
• Lead the CLI, defining its strategy, organisation, governance and priorities, and establishing clear accountability across the department.
• Establish and maintain a strong, risk-based control environment, ensuring that all activities within the CLI’s remit are effective, consistent and compliant with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank’s risk tolerance.
• Provide senior leadership and direction on complex or sensitive cases and operational matters, driving appropriate escalation and decision-making.
• Represent the CLI at Senior Management and in relevant governance bodies, and act as a strategic partner to the Executive Management, the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department and other key stakeholders.
• Serve as a senior point of contact for FINMA, auditors and other relevant external stakeholders within the CLI’s area of responsibility.
• Drive high standards, quality and effectiveness across the different CLI activities, supported by appropriate policies, procedures, controls, management information and risk and performance indicators.
• Ensure timely reporting of key risk and performance indicators to the Executive Management and relevant governance bodies.
• Build and develop a high-performing management team and foster a culture of strong control, collaboration and operational excellence.
• Contribute to the preparation of external and internal audits, inspections as well as regulatory reviews.
2. Client Onboarding, Integrity-related Lifecycle Management & AML Transaction Monitoring
• Oversee private client onboarding (incl. with respect to prospects introduced or managed by Group foreign entities), in line with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank’s risk tolerance.
• Oversee integrity-related lifecycle activities, including periodic and event-driven reviews, changes in circumstances, account maintenance, dormant account processes and closures, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.
• Oversee AML transaction monitoring across all client segments, ensuring effective identification, assessment and escalation of potentially suspicious activities.
• Ensure appropriate risk management and robust governance for complex or high-risk client relationships and transactions, while maintaining effective collaboration with Front Office and the Compliance Department.
3. Process Effectiveness, Automation & Continuous Improvement
• Continuously enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CLI processes, with a focus on optimisation, automation and digitalisation.
• Identify and implement opportunities to leverage technology, data, analytics, workflow solutions and AI to reduce manual activities, improve quality, consistency and risk effectiveness and ensure compliance.
• Establish and monitor appropriate operational and quality metrics to identify performance gaps, assess outcomes and support informed management decisions.
• Work closely with technology functions as well as other relevant stakeholders to deliver sustainable improvements across client onboarding, integrity-related lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring as well as anticipate and adapt to the evolving client onboarding and lifecycle landscapes.
• Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging teams to challenge existing ways of working and identify practical opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and control effectiveness.

Qualifications
• 10+ years of professional experience in a leadership position in Operations, Compliance, AML, Risk Management or similar functions within a banking, financial services or fintech environment.
• Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Law, Business Administration or equivalent degree.
• Proven track record in process optimisation, automation, digitalisation and operational excellence.
• A relevant certification in project management, process improvement or transformation (e.g. PMP) is considered an asset.
• Strong understanding of how data, technology, workflow tools and AI can be used to enhance control effectiveness, decision-making and operational efficiency.
• Strong expertise in client onboarding, KYC/AML, client lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring, with a broad understanding of related legal and regulatory requirements.
• Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities, particularly when dealing with complex or high-impact regulatory and operational matters.
• Demonstrated experience managing and developing large and diverse teams, with a strong track record of building high-performing management structures, developing talent and leadership capabilities, and establishing effective career development and succession planning frameworks.
• Past exposure to Executive Management, regulators, auditors and senior internal stakeholders.
• High level of integrity, sound judgement and professional credibility, combined with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative leadership approach.
• Native French or English speaker, with full professional fluency in the other language.

The Role:
We are looking for a Software Development AI Technical Expert to serve as the department’s designated AI specialist and lead the responsible evaluation, adoption and practical application of AI across Software Development and Software Quality Assurance.
 
The role will research emerging AI technologies, support experimentation and pilot projects, and translate successful solutions into practical tools, standards and development practices. You will provide technical guidance on AI-enabled development, code quality, security, AI advocacy, capability building and impact measurement.
 
You will work closely with Software Development and Software Quality Assurance teams to develop practical, responsible and measurable AI-native ways of working that improve productivity, quality, security and innovation.
 


The main responsibilities of the position include:
• Act as the subject-matter specialist for AI-enabled Software Development and Software Quality Assurance, maintaining current knowledge of large language models, AI development tools, AI agents and emerging technologies.

• Research and benchmark AI applications, tools, vendors and industry practices, assessing their relevance, maturity, limitations, security and potential value to the organisation.

• Provide expert advice on the practical and technical application of AI across the Software Development Lifecycle, from requirements and design through coding, testing, deployment and monitoring.

• Explore, prototype and evaluate AI capabilities and use cases, defining clear objectives, success criteria, evaluation methods and recommendations.

• Contribute to AI pilots from concept through implementation and evaluation, identifying lessons learned, adoption requirements and opportunities for scaling successful solutions.

• Support the transition of approved AI tools and practices into Software Development and Software Quality Assurance, including AI code assistants, automated code review, AI-supported testing and intelligent CI/CD practices.

• Develop guidance, standards and best practices for the responsible use of AI and AI-generated code, covering quality assurance, security, data protection, intellectual property, maintainability and human oversight.

• Establish and monitor measures of AI effectiveness and impact, including output quality, reliability, usability, developer experience, cycle time, defect rates, deployment frequency, test coverage and rework.

• Assess the AI maturity of Software Development and Software Quality Assurance teams and recommend practical actions to improve organisational capability.

• Support cultural change, knowledge-sharing and upskilling through playbooks, prompt libraries, FAQs, onboarding materials, reusable templates, case studies and communities of practice.

• Collaborate with stakeholders across IT, the Group and other departments to identify and assess AI opportunities aligned with business priorities, roadmaps and projects.

• Collaborate with AI representatives across the Group to share knowledge and support a coordinated approach to AI adoption.

• Maintain relationships with vendors, research communities and industry peers, bringing relevant developments and insights back to the organisation.

• Represent the Group, when requested, at conferences, external events and industry forums, contributing to presentations, demonstrations, articles and other technology-related activities.

Main requirements:
• BSc/MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• At least 7 years of experience in IT engineering roles, including experience in a managerial or leadership role within a Software Development team.

• Solid working knowledge of the modern AI landscape, including Large Language Models, AI agents, automation platforms, prompt engineering techniques and practical business applications.

• Demonstrated experience modernising or transforming software development lifecycles through AI tooling and automation.

• Deep understanding of modern SDLC practices, including CI/CD, DevOps and platform engineering, combined with hands-on experience with AI-powered development tools.

• Strong Machine Learning and AI background, with hands-on experience building, prototyping or deploying AI solutions.

• Experience contributing to governance frameworks covering quality assurance, security review or intellectual property considerations for AI-generated outputs.

• Solid understanding of IT engineering metrics and data-driven measurement of development performance.

• Exposure to AI or IT engineering maturity models and experience assessing team capabilities against defined frameworks.

• Experience evaluating technology vendors and AI tooling through trials, benchmarking and recommendations.

• Experience presenting to and working directly with senior or C-level stakeholders.

• Public speaking or conference presentation experience in AI or technology, with the ability to inspire technical and non-technical audiences.

• Innovative and curious mindset, with the ability to explore emerging technologies, challenge unsupported claims and identify practical applications.

• Proficiency in written and spoken English.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in fast-paced environments.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities.

• Willingness and ability to continuously learn and upskill.

The following will be considered an advantage:
• Experience in fintech, trading or financial services.

• Experience working with or within an innovation lab or applied research environment.

• Experience with AI or IT engineering maturity frameworks.

• Experience representing an organisation at external technology events and industry forums.

Role Overview

This is a hands-on, full-cycle role that owns the whole fraud control loop: investigate, analyze, set up rules, monitor, and improve. You will work tickets daily, turn what you find into data-backed fraud rules and strategies, monitor how they perform, and keep refining them. Each stage feeds the next.

You will own the card risk control strategy, from set-up through ongoing performance, and be accountable for the fraud rate and the interception rate.

Key Responsibilities

1. Investigation

•

Handle card risk tickets daily: review rule-triggered alerts, investigate suspicious accounts and transactions, and decide on block, decline, step-up, or card-lifecycle actions within SLA

•

Investigate fraud typologies: account takeover, card testing, BIN attacks, merchant collusion, friendly fraud, and first-party abuse

•

Assess merchant and transaction risk by MCC risk type, including high-risk merchants and non-card payment flows

•

Manage disputes and chargebacks end to end under Visa/Mastercard rules: evidence, representation, pre-arbitration, and arbitration

2. Data Analysis

•

Turn investigation findings into patterns: analyze ticket, alert, and transaction data to identify fraud trends, attack vectors, and coverage gaps

•

Measure false positives against loss to judge whether existing rules are effective

3. Rule Set-up

•

Design and set up fraud rules, velocity limits, and strategies based on the analysis

•

Make sure rule triggers and decisions stay compliant; escalate linked AML/sanctions concerns to Compliance

4. Rule Monitoring

•

Continuously monitor alert and ticket data after rules go live

•

Track and report KPIs: fraud loss rate (bps), chargeback ratio, approval rate, alert handling time, recovery rate

•

Keep the programme within scheme monitoring thresholds (e.g. VAMP, ECM/EFM) and support scheme and partner audits

5. Rule Improvement

•

Adjust, retire, and add rules in response to monitoring results, balancing fraud loss against false positives and approval rate

•

Feed fraud trends back to Product and Engineering to improve onboarding, 3DS, and authorisation controls

Requirements

•

3+ years in card fraud strategy or payments risk at an issuer, EMI, neobank, PSP, or card programme manager

•

Proven hands-on experience building and tuning fraud rules and strategies, not only working tickets

•

Hands-on knowledge of Visa and/or Mastercard dispute rules, reason codes, and chargeback timelines

•

Experience with MCC-based risk, high-risk merchants, and non-card payments

•

Strong data skills: SQL and Excel/Sheets to pull, slice, and explain fraud trends

•

Fluent English; Mandarin or other European languages are a plus

Nice to Have

•

Crypto-linked or prepaid/debit card programme experience, including crypto-to-fiat conversion at authorisation

•

Card risk control experience across multiple countries/regions

•

Experience launching a card programme in a new market or with a new BIN sponsor

•

Scheme monitoring programme remediation experience

•

Python or BI tooling (Looker, Tableau, Metabase)

•

Certifications: CFE, ACAMS, or equivalent

About the Job

We are looking for a Salesforce Business Analyst to play a central role in our move from a legacy CRM to Salesforce. At IC, Salesforce is where our sales, retention, partner, compliance and support teams work every day, and the rules behind it are rich: who owns a client depends on their region, how they joined and whether they trade or introduce others, and what each team can see depends on role and regulated entity. You will be the bridge between those teams and our developers and QA, turning how the business really works into clear user stories, sound process and access designs, and an org people want to use. If you enjoy untangling complex processes, asking the question nobody has asked yet and seeing a requirement through to UAT, we’d like to hear from you.

What you’ll own

• Run workshops, interviews and process walkthroughs with Sales, Partners, Compliance and Support to understand how work is really done.

• Map current and future-state processes for the CRM migration, from sign-up through onboarding to trading, and identify gaps against the legacy system.

• Write clear user stories with acceptance criteria in Jira, plus BDD scenarios or specifications where a story needs more detail, traceable from business goal to delivered feature.

• Work with the Product Owner, Salesforce Architect, developers and QA to shape scalable solutions that follow Salesforce best practice.

• Contribute to defining data models, assignment rules and access requirements with the Salesforce technical team.

• Plan data migration with the technical team: field mapping, data quality rules and validation of migrated records.

• Maintain process documentation, data dictionaries, user guides and training materials, and drive user adoption after each release.

• Define and run test cases for system, integration and user acceptance testing, support production validation, and triage issues with QA and developers through to root cause.

• Use AI tools such as Claude to draft BRDs, stories and UAT scenarios and to surface edge cases, checking every output before it is used.

• Identify where automation or AI agents could remove manual work for sales and support teams.

• Define how success is measured, such as handling time, manual touches and conversion, and track it after release.

• Run demos and status updates, and communicate progress, risks and dependencies to management.

What you’ll need

Essential

• 5+ years as a Salesforce Business Analyst.

• Proven experience on a CRM migration or system transformation project.

• Strong knowledge of the Salesforce data model and core clouds, especially Sales and Service Cloud.

• Salesforce Administrator, Sales Cloud and Service Cloud Consultant certification.

• User stories, acceptance criteria and process flows that developers and testers can work from without guessing.

• A working understanding of Salesforce security: profiles, permission sets, roles and sharing.

• Experience in trading or financial services: client onboarding, partner management or compliance workflows.

• Agile/Scrum delivery with Jira.

• Effective prompting of AI tools such as Claude, including AI-assisted test case design for UAT.

Desirable

• A business analysis certification, such as Salesforce Certified Business Analyst, IIBA CBAP or CCBA, or PMI-PBA

• Data migration projects and large data sets, including Data Loader or similar tools

• Agentforce and AI-powered automation: defining agent use cases and taking them through UAT

• Brokerage or fintech experience: KYC/AML, trading account types, MT4, MT5 or cTrader, IB models

• Process modelling in tools such as Miro, Lucidchart or Visio

• Basic SQL or SOQL and Postman, to check data and API payloads yourself

• Multi-region, multi-language orgs

About the Job

We are looking for a Salesforce Developer who approaches Salesforce development through the lens of modern software engineering. At IC, Salesforce is where our sales, retention, partner and support teams work every day. We maintain a modular DX codebase, enforce clean object-oriented design patterns, build Lightning Web Components to a consistent design system, and follow strict code-quality and testing practices. If you enjoy writing clean, decoupled Apex, designing reactive and localised LWC frontends, and working in a modern Git and scratch-org workflow without legacy clutter, we’d like to hear from you.

What you’ll own

• Turn requirements into technical designs, then deliver Apex and Lightning Web Components for our support, sales, KYC, trading account, payment and partner workflows.

• Work with our trigger framework and Unit of Work, query builder, collection utilities, async actions and batch frameworks.

• Build reusable Lightning Web Components to our design system, with a custom label for every string and locale-aware formatting.

• Build and maintain REST integrations with payload validation, resilient error handling and mockable tests.

• Write bulkified, governor-aware code and async pipelines, and resolve performance bottlenecks and technical debt.

• Implement permission set groups, custom permissions, sharing and field-level security for every new feature.

• Write deterministic tests that check behaviour, not just coverage.

• Release through scratch orgs, pull requests and automated validation, from stage to UAT to production.

• Own features from design to production, delivering scalable, well-documented code to our engineering standards.

What you’ll need

Essential

• 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development in an enterprise org.

• Strong Apex: triggers, Queueable, Batch and Scheduled jobs, bulkification and governor limits.

• Strong LWC and modern JavaScript (ES6+): lifecycle hooks, reactivity and component composition.

• Object-oriented design: SOLID principles and common design patterns.

• REST integrations: outbound callouts, inbound Apex REST, JSON, and Named and External Credentials.

• Solid SOQL skills: selective queries, indexing and safe dynamic query generation for large data volumes.

• Salesforce DX, sf CLI, Git, GitHub and a pull-request workflow.

• Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.

Your approach

• You read existing code before adding to it, and your changes look like they belong.

• You ask what problem a ticket solves before you estimate it, and flag gaps in a requirement early.

• You support your features after release and fix your own bugs first.

• You communicate clearly with developers, BAs and QA, including colleagues in other time zones.

• You’re keen to learn the trading domain: accounts, IBs, KYC and multi-entity regulation.

Desirable

• Salesforce Platform Developer II, or a Sales/Service Cloud Consultant certification

• Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, or GitHub Copilot) for code generation, Apex/LWC refactoring, test class generation, and rapid debugging.

• Unlocked packages and package-based development

• Event-driven design with Platform Events

• Service Cloud experience, including CTI and call-centre integrations

• Brokerage or fintech experience: KYC/AML, MT4, MT5 or cTrader, IB models

OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Hong Kong, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Product Manager with a deep understanding of TradingView users, strong commercial judgment, and experience driving product growth. You will grow OKX's business within the TradingView ecosystem by identifying the most promising customer segments, defining why traders should choose OKX, and finding effective ways to acquire, activate, and retain them, with accountability for measurable business outcomes.

Your first priority is to establish how the business can grow and which opportunities warrant investment. You will validate growth hypotheses through user research, data analysis, and focused experiments before committing substantial engineering resources. Those insights will shape the product roadmap, investment priorities, and the TradingView integrations and trading experience improvements you deliver with engineering and partners.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Define the Growth Strategy and Business Opportunity —

Identify high-potential customer segments, trading use cases, and market opportunities within the TradingView ecosystem. Assess competitive positioning, platform selection drivers, and OKX's differentiated value proposition. Build growth hypotheses and business cases that consider audience size, revenue potential, acquisition cost, and expected return, then set business goals, priorities, and a phased growth plan.

• Understand Users and the Trading Conversion Journey —

Use interviews, behavioral data, and community feedback to understand how traders discover platforms, use charts and indicators, set alerts, connect accounts, place orders, and manage positions. Identify what motivates or prevents users from choosing OKX, making their first trade, and returning. Develop customer segments and conversion funnels, and turn insights into clear product, positioning, and lifecycle opportunities.

• Validate Growth Hypotheses and Improve Conversion and Retention —

Design measurable experiments across acquisition, account connection, first successful trade, repeat trading, and reactivation. Use existing capabilities, onboarding, trader education, value proposition testing, and targeted campaigns to validate opportunities. Define success metrics, experiment costs, and criteria to scale or stop; expand approaches that work and use the evidence to inform subsequent product investment.

• Drive Go-To-Market and Ecosystem Partnerships —

Work with marketing, regional, lifecycle, and TradingView partner teams on acquisition and go-to-market plans. Evaluate ecosystem visibility, communities, creators, educational content, and joint campaigns as potential channels. Define the customer proposition, distribution approach, conversion journey, and partner objectives, and assess channels by the active traders, retention, and business contribution they generate.

• Translate Growth Evidence into Product Delivery and Integration —

Translate validated user needs and growth opportunities into a product roadmap, PRDs, and acceptance criteria. Define the minimum scope and engineering priorities required to achieve the business objective. Work with OKX engineering and TradingView technical teams to assess API integration, account authorization, market data, and order and position synchronization, and drive the necessary adaptation, testing, and launch to address specific conversion, trust, or retention problems.

• Own Business Outcomes and Continuously Refine Investment —

Own metrics for newly acquired trading users, first-trade conversion, active traders, retention, incremental trading volume, and revenue contribution, taking acquisition, incentive, and delivery costs into account. Separate the effects of market conditions, incentives, and product improvements. Review growth initiatives and feature investments, reallocate resources based on results, and track connection success and trading reliability as measures of experience quality.

What We Look For In You

•

Relevant product management experience in trading, fintech, or digital assets, with a track record of measurable product growth. You can explain how you identified opportunities, developed a growth strategy, and improved acquisition, trading conversion, retention, or revenue, including your personal contribution and results.

•

A deep understanding of TradingView users and their practical use of charts, indicators, watchlists, alerts, and trading workflows. You can explain why different traders choose a platform, switch terminals, abandon an order, or continue using a service, and validate those insights through research and data.

•

Strong commercial judgment and growth strategy skills. You can segment customers, assess opportunities, define differentiated positioning, select distribution channels, and build business cases. You validate demand and a credible path to growth through research and focused experiments before substantial engineering investment.

•

Strong analytical and experimentation skills. You can analyze funnels, cohorts, and retention, design and evaluate growth experiments, and assess incrementality, acquisition cost, customer value, and incentive cost. You can distinguish short-term trading volume changes from sustainable growth.

•

An understanding of trading products and their commercial drivers. You are familiar with spot and derivatives fundamentals and how instrument coverage, fees, liquidity, execution quality, and account and position workflows influence customer choice, conversion, and retention. You can translate these factors into product decisions.

•

Experience delivering products that involve technical integration. You have worked with engineers on API or third-party platform integrations and can read interface documentation, understand account authorization and market data, order, and position synchronization, define business rules and acceptance criteria, and drive testing and launch. You connect technical constraints and implementation scope to user value and growth objectives.

•

Strong English communication and cross-functional execution skills. You can work with TradingView partners, marketing, regional, product, and engineering teams on business opportunities, product priorities, and technical feasibility, aligning resources around shared outcomes.

Nice-To-Haves

•

Experience growing a business within TradingView or a comparable trading-tool ecosystem, with examples spanning opportunity discovery, growth validation, and scaling.

•

Experience with trader communities, creators, educational content, partnerships, or channel growth, with the ability to evaluate initiatives by active traders, retention, and revenue contribution.

•

Experience growing products across regions or trader segments, with an understanding of differences in user behavior, customer propositions, and acquisition approaches.

•

Experience with TradingView Broker Integration, Advanced Charts, Trading Platform, or comparable integrations, with an ability to explain how the work improved the user experience or supported growth objectives.

What Success Looks Like

•

An evidence-based growth plan that identifies priority customer segments, OKX's differentiated value, promising distribution channels, and the business opportunity.

•

Validated, repeatable approaches to acquisition, trading conversion, and retention, supported by research and focused experiments that guide engineering investment and resource allocation.

•

Measurable, sustainable growth in active traders, retention, and revenue contribution, with acquisition and incentive costs taken into account.

•

Delivery of the product capabilities and TradingView integrations needed to capture validated opportunities, with improvements to critical user journeys and ongoing measurement of their growth impact.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

• L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

• Wellness and meal allowances

• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Trading to own trading products on the Crypto.com App end-to-end. Retail trading is where users feel the product every day - and where volume, engagement, and retention compound. Every improvement you ship shows up in how people trade, how often they come back, and how Crypto.com wins share in a crowded market.
Your mandate is to drive trading products from discovery through launch and iteration: roadmap clarity, feature definition, customer insight, and shipping at global scale. 
You will run your roadmap with independence within Trading's strategic priorities. You prioritize initiatives, cut tradeoffs, and make the call on what ships when. You report to the Senior Director of Product Management, who sets strategic direction. You own the how and the when.
If you've shipped trading or financial products at scale, this will feel familiar. The difference is you'll be doing it at the frontier of crypto retail trading- perpetuals, spot, and adjacent markets- where the rails keep moving and the playbook is yours to write. No layers. No politics.
 


What You'll Actually Do:
• Own the Trading roadmap. You set milestones, surface dependencies, and keep strategic priorities honest. You make the prioritization call when everything can't ship at once.

• Define and ship trading experiences. You write the specs, run user studies, iterate on feedback, partner with QA on test plans, and clear the backlog. Nothing in your charter goes live without your sign-off.

• Stay close to how traders actually behave. You interview and observe customers. You ask "Show me how you currently trade and manage risk," not "Would you use this feature?" You distinguish what they say from what their behavior reveals.

• Cut the hard tradeoffs. You weigh speed vs. depth, retail clarity vs. power-user needs, and compliance constraints vs. product ambition- and you own the decision.

• Drive market and competitive clarity. You run the research that informs what we build next. Your work shows up in the roadmap, not a slide deck that dies in a folder.

• Cross-functional leadership without authority. You can describe a time you aligned Design, Engineering, QA, Marketing, Compliance, and Growth toward a ship date, and how you unblocked the team when it stalled.

Global consumer product: You've launched and iterated across regions with different regulatory and UX constraints.

Frontier of retail crypto. Spot, perpetuals, and the next wave of markets- the playbook isn't finished. You'll write parts of it.

Autonomy with teeth. You own the roadmap and ship decisions inside a clear strategic frame. Access to the teams that matter. No theater.

As Associate Director for Quality Control & Remediations, you will lead the team responsible for final quality checks on account openings and periodic reviews across New Client Onboarding and Existing Clients, ensuring operational excellence and alignment with BRM standards and strategic priorities.
Key Responsibilities
• Direct the operational and people management aspects of the Quality Control (QC) & Remediations team, fostering a high-performance culture aligned to strategic objectives.

• Produce qualitative and quantitative reporting on return reasons and QC trends, providing senior management with clear visibility on where and why cases are being returned.

• Coach and mentor team members, supporting their skill development and career growth.

A junior Controls Analyst sits in the second line and does the groundwork that keeps the control environment visible — maintaining the inventory, gathering evidence, testing controls.

Core responsibilities

Risk and control framework

•

Maintain the approved control inventory, including control descriptions, owners, frequency and evidence requirements; process additions through the agreed governance process.

•

Map controls to processes, risks and applicable obligations. Identify control gaps, duplicate controls, outdated records and missing ownership for review.

•

Support Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) cycles by collecting inputs, checking completeness and recording changes to risks, controls and action plans.

Evidence and control testing

•

Request and organise evidence from control owners across departments, maintain an accessible audit trail and follow up on overdue submissions.

•

Perform sample-based second-line testing under an approved test plan, assessing control design and operating effectiveness as applicable.

•

Document the test scope, sample, evidence, results and conclusion. Distinguish control failures from cases that cannot be tested because evidence is unavailable, and escalate material findings.

Issues and remediation

•

Record control deficiencies and agreed actions with clear descriptions, owners, due dates and status; follow up on overdue or recurring issues.

•

Review evidence of completed actions and, where required, retest before recommending closure. Escalate unresolved matters through the agreed process.

Cross-department control monitoring dashboards

•

Build and maintain dashboards that monitor key controls across departments against agreed thresholds, including control performance, overdue evidence, testing exceptions, open issues and remediation timeliness.

•

Work with risk and control owners to document approved indicators, thresholds, data sources, review frequency and escalation triggers. Check that dashboard data is consistent, complete and traceable to the underlying records.

•

Monitor threshold breaches and adverse trends, investigate anomalies with control owners, and escalate exceptions with clear context and action status through periodic risk reports and governance meetings.

GRC records and audit support

•

Keep risk, control, process, evidence and issue records current in the GRC tool; run data quality checks and prepare standard reporting extracts.

•

Prepare relevant records and evidence for internal audit, external audit and regulatory reviews in coordination with the wider team.

Requirements

•

Attention to the details and result oriented

•

One to three years of relevant experience in operational risk, internal controls, internal audit, compliance or a regulated operating environment.

•

Strong Excel skills, including the ability to consolidate and check data, use formulas and pivot tables, and build clear dashboards or management reports.

•

Ability to understand process flows and risk and control relationships, apply a defined testing method, and write clear findings supported by evidence.

•

Clear written and spoken English, German language nice to have

About the Opportunity

Our team has built and operates the infrastructure connecting OKX to dozens of payment channels across global markets, giving users deposit and withdrawal options that are fast, convenient, and — most importantly — trustworthy. Expand our global reach. Help integrate and scale new payment channels and methods across markets, each with its own technical, operational, and reliability characteristics.

Protect user assets. Build for correctness first: consistency, idempotency, reconciliation, failure recovery, and the operational tooling that lets us stand behind every transaction.

Stay curious. Keep pace with a fast-moving industry and bring the good ideas back.

Deep, practical fluency across a wide range of global payment methods and channels — knowledge that is genuinely hard to acquire anywhere else

Experience designing and operating systems entrusted with substantial user assets, where correctness and recoverability are non-negotiable

A track record of shipping in a regulated, high-stakes domain at real scale

Together, both brands have built a leading global presence in online trading serving over two million clients in 150 countries from regulated centres across four continents.
Exinity is an energetic and diverse company with offices across Europe, Asia and Africa, and we’re always looking for talented individuals to join us. ‘Freedom to Succeed’ is not just a promise we make to our clients and partners, but to our people too. We’ll help you develop a range of skills, take on early responsibility, and enjoy a rewarding and fulfilling career with a fast-growing, dynamic company.

Job Description
We are looking for a highly experienced QA Automation Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our real-time trading systems in a global Forex/CFD environment.

You will work closely with developers, product teams, and dealing/risk departments to design robust automated testing frameworks for pricing, order execution, trading cores, market data feeds, risk engines, and integrations with external liquidity providers.
Responsibilities
Automated Testing
•
Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive automated test suites covering:
•
order execution flows
•
market data distribution
•
risk calculations
•
Build frameworks for deterministic simulation of trading scenarios and edge cases.
Performance & Stress Testing
•
Implement and manage stress, latency, throughput, and stability tests for:
•
trading cores
•
pricing engines
•
real-time message pipelines
•
Detect bottlenecks, resource leaks, deadlocks
Quality Engineering & Analysis
•
Analyze business requirements, trading/risk logic, and code to ensure full test coverage of critical flows.
•
Work with developers and quants to identify root causes, validate fixes, and improve system resilience.
•
Build tools to automate operational testing tasks and regression checks.
Automation Operations
•
Ensure reliability of tests in distributed environments with eventually consistent data.
•
Maintain and improve AI framework.

Qualifications
Essential
•
Extensive experience in test automation and software development (5+ years preferred).
•
Strong coding skills in Python.
•
Strong experience with AI tools and agentic approach.
•
Strong understanding of:
•
concurrent systems
•
distributed microservices
•
event-driven architectures
•
Experience testing systems that use:
•
API (REST, gRPC, GraphQL)
•
Message brokers (Kafka, NATS, Redis Streams)
•
Deep understanding of software testing principles:

functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, performance testing, non-functional requirements.
•
Strong troubleshooting skills (profiling, metrics, logs, distributed tracing).
•
Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.
Nice to Have
•
Understanding of the Forex trading domain, including:
•
order types
•
execution models (A-book/B-book)
•
market data (ticks, L2)
•
risk systems (margin, exposure)
•
Experience testing FIX protocol integrations.
•
Experience with:
•
Docker/Kubernetes
•
GitLab CI/CD
•
monitoring/observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry)

We’re hiring a Product Manager with deep UX and interaction design expertise to build social experiences around investing and trading at Kraken.


You should be comfortable designing flows yourself, building interactive prototypes, and working through interaction details with designers and engineers. You’ll also own the product decisions: which customer problem to solve, what to ship first, and how to measure whether the experience improved.




THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation.

 - Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind.

 - Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria.

 - Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute.

 - Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action.

 - Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first.

 - Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences.

 - Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - Has designed and shipped consumer social experiences. Your portfolio shows your contribution to feeds, profiles, sharing, messaging, discovery, or communities—and how the experience changed after launch.

 - Has strong interaction design craft. You can explain why a flow is structured a particular way, what users will notice first, what they need to understand, and which decisions or steps can be removed.

 - Can build realistic interactive prototypes. You use Figma, code, AI tools, or a combination to make behavior tangible and testable, including transitions, empty states, and failure states.

 - Understands behavior through evidence. You can show where user research challenged your assumptions and changed a design.

 - Can own product outcomes. You can prioritize a problem, define success, interpret funnel and cohort data, and explain whether an experiment produced a meaningful improvement.

 - Understands the context of social finance. You account for how credibility, incentives, reputation, and visibility of financial activity affect what people trust and choose to share.

We are looking for a hands-on VP, Product Analytics to lead Product Analytics and build an AI-native analytics operating system across the company’s crypto, stocks, prediction markets, perpetuals, and stock futures products.
You will set the analytics strategy, lead and develop the Product Analytics team, and ensure data consistently shapes product and business decisions. This is a player-coach role: you will operate at executive level while remaining technically close enough to review PRs, guide data modeling and pipeline design, and challenge analytical conclusions.
You will own product and business reporting, experimentation, release measurement, diagnostic analysis, the Amplitude data stack, and the systems through which analytics work is delivered at scale.


Lead Product Analytics
•

Set the vision, priorities, operating model, and quality standards for Product Analytics.

•

Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team.

•

Review analytical and data-engineering PRs, providing guidance on SQL, data models, pipelines, metric definitions, and methodology.

•

Represent Product Analytics in executive and product decision-making.

•

Allocate team capacity toward the company’s highest-impact opportunities.

Build an AI-native analytics operating system
•

Design how analytics work moves from business questions to trusted decisions across intake, data discovery, analysis, validation, reporting, and knowledge management.

•

Build reusable AI tools to automate repetitive workflows, encode analytical standards, and improve the speed, quality, and consistency of delivery.

•

Establish appropriate governance, validation, and human review for high-stakes decisions.

•

Measure the system’s impact on turnaround time, analytical quality, experimentation throughput, and team capacity.

Own product and business reporting
•

Establish trusted KPIs, source-of-truth metrics, dashboards, and executive business reviews.

•

Ensure reporting is accurate, consistent, and focused on decisions—not simply monitoring performance.

•

Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, CRM, Growth, and other functions to align definitions, priorities, and business interpretation.

Build an experimentation culture
•

Make experimentation and evidence core parts of product development.

•

Establish standards for hypotheses, success metrics, guardrails, experiment design, causal interpretation, and rollout decisions.

•

Use AI and automation to streamline experiment intake, validation, analysis, and readouts while maintaining analytical rigor.

•

Help product teams move from opinion-led decisions to repeatable test-and-learn practices.

Own analytics platforms and data quality
•

Own the Amplitude data stack, including instrumentation strategy, event taxonomy, governance, data quality, and integration with warehouse reporting.

•

Set standards for product instrumentation and ensure new releases can be measured reliably.

•

Set standards for and review analytical models and pipelines, ensuring metrics remain traceable, reproducible, and trusted as products evolve.

Drive high-impact analysis
•

Lead diagnostic deep-dives into activation, conversion, retention, user behavior, market liquidity, trading execution performance, and product health.

•

Define measurement frameworks and success criteria for major product launches.

•

Oversee post-release evaluations that inform whether the company should iterate, scale, or stop.

•

Identify root causes, challenge weak hypotheses, and translate complex findings into clear recommendations and product actions.

What Success Looks Like: 
•

Leadership operates from trusted, consistent product and business metrics.

•

The Product Analytics team has clear priorities, strong technical standards, and consistently high-quality output.

•

AI-enabled workflows materially improve analytical speed, quality, and capacity.

•

Product teams use experimentation and evidence as standard parts of development.

•

Amplitude instrumentation and taxonomy are reliable, governed, and useful.

•

Major product launches have clear success criteria and rigorous post-release evaluation.

•

High-impact analyses lead to concrete product, operational, and business decisions.

Qualifications: 
•

Proven experience leading Product Analytics teams in a complex, fast-moving organization.

•

Strong hands-on technical judgment, advanced SQL, and experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks.

•

Demonstrated experience using AI to redesign analytics operations—not merely improve individual productivity.

•

Ability to design and implement AI-enabled workflows, reusable agents or tools, validation controls, and analytics knowledge systems.

•

Experience owning a product analytics platform; deep Amplitude experience is strongly preferred.

•

Strong knowledge of experimentation, causal inference, product measurement, and diagnostic analysis.

•

Ability to turn ambiguous business questions into rigorous analysis and clear decisions.

•

Strong product judgment, people leadership, and executive communication skills.

Preferred Experience: 
•

Consumer fintech, trading, marketplaces, or other transaction-heavy products.

•

Exchange mechanics, market liquidity, and experience with multi-asset products.

•

Leading company-wide adoption of new analytics technologies and ways of working.

NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers, and potential to turn into performance. With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

Your Role in Our Mission
As the Senior HR Business Partner, you’ll play a pivotal role in translating our business vision into people strategy across Southeast Asia, South Asia, and EMEA. You will partner with senior leaders in trading, technology, and operations to drive organizational effectiveness, talent growth, and performance excellence. This role is about connecting business momentum with people capability—ensuring every region’s growth is powered by the right structure, leadership, and culture.

How You’ll Make an Impact
Strategic HR Partnership

Serve as a trusted advisor to regional and functional leaders on people strategy, organizational health, and performance.

Translate global business priorities into localized people plans that advance firm-wide OKRs and regional growth objectives.

Anticipate workforce challenges—skills, retention, engagement—and co-develop proactive solutions with HR Centers of Excellence (CoEs).

Collaboration with Global HR CoEs

Partner with HR Analytics to interpret data on headcount, attrition, and performance trends for strategic workforce decisions.
•
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely, high-quality hiring aligned with regional business demand.
•
Coordinate with Learning & Development on leadership capability, upskilling, and talent readiness initiatives.
•
Partner with People Operations on employee experience, compliance, and cross-border mobility programs.
Organizational Design & Workforce Planning
•
Partner with business leaders to structure teams effectively for speed, scalability, and performance.
•
Conduct organizational health reviews and ensure optimal spans, succession, and leadership depth.
•
Collaborate with Finance and HR Analytics to deliver integrated regional workforce plans that balance cost, capability, and agility.
Performance & OKR Management
•
Cascade and monitor performance goals and OKRs, ensuring alignment with global and regional priorities.
•
Coach managers on feedback culture, performance differentiation, and growth planning.
•
Use data analytics to assess and refine performance frameworks, ensuring measurable impact on business results.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management
•
Mentor regional HRBPs to deliver high-impact HR solutions across multiple markets.
•
Act as a bridge between global HRBP leadership and regional business stakeholders, driving consistency and alignment.
•
Influence through insight and data, earning credibility across diverse functions and leadership levels

What You Bring
•
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related discipline (Master’s preferred).
•
10+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 5 years in HRBP or HR leadership roles within financial services, fintech, or trading industries.
•
Demonstrated success in partnering with global HR CoEs (Rewards, Analytics, Talent Acquisition, L&D).
•
Proven experience designing and embedding OKR-based performance and workforce frameworks.
•
Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with comfort using data to drive decisions.
•
Exceptional stakeholder management, influencing, and problem-solving skills in dynamic, high-stakes environments.
•
Solid understanding of regional labor laws, compliance, and HR best practices across SEA, South Asia, and EMEA.

Your X-Factor

Moves seamlessly between strategy and execution, translating complex business needs into actionable people plans.
•
Builds trust through insight and empathy, balancing business priorities with human outcomes.
•
Champions data-driven decisions and challenges assumptions with confidence and credibility.

Elevates others—coaching HRBPs and leaders to operate with clarity, purpose, and performance mindset.

Your Journey After Applying

30-minute HR Session with the Talent Acquisition team
•
60-minute Strategic Discussion with the Global HRBP Leader
•
Final Interview with the Chief People Officer
•
Physical chat with CEO

Why Join NEXT
At NEXT Ventures, people are our greatest advantage—and our boldest investment. Here, HR isn’t a support function; it’s a growth engine. Join us to lead the evolution of people strategy across regions, shape the future of work in a fast-scaling fintech, and help great talent unlock global impact.
Your next big move starts here.

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE


Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.

The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)

 - Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases

 - Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

 - Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale

 - Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding

 - Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business

 - Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers

 - Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

 
 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers

 - Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them

 - Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect

 - Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components

 - Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on

 - Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority

 - Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

 
 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house

 - Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms

 - Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps

 - Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

 
 
 



Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.




OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.


We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.


As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.



Stay connected

Follow us on X https://twitter.com/krakenfx

Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address

Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/


Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.kraken.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice
