Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Team

The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for the overall compliance program and culture of the company. We’re a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on the company’s regulatory obligations and enterprise risk.

About the Opportunity

The successful candidate will have prior transaction monitoring/investigations experience in the financial services, FinTech or cryptocurrency industries. You will help support the Special Investigations team, focusing on analyzing blockchain data to identify potential illicit activities, money laundering and terrorist financing, involving cryptocurrencies. The job requires a mix of technical expertise, investigative skills, and knowledge of crypto markets and blockchain technology.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Conduct in-depth investigations of complex AML cases, ensuring thorough analysis and adherence to regulatory requirements, through investigation of blockchain transactions to track and identify suspicious or illicit activities such as money laundering, and other criminal activities.

•

Analyze data to identify process gaps and opportunities, and partner with Compliance, Training and other FIU stakeholders to recommend mitigating activities for risk and close process gaps.

•

Evaluate AML transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting requirements for all countries where applicable.

•

Collaborate with external partners, including financial institutions, government agencies, and blockchain companies, to share intelligence and insights. Work closely with law enforcement agencies, regulators, and legal teams to provide insights and evidence for criminal investigations.

•

Stay abreast of changes to the cryptocurrency industry, financial crime trends, and regulatory requirements to assess impact to Transaction Monitoring.

•

Support team training and knowledge sharing, fostering a collaborative environment focused on ongoing learning and professional growth.

What We Look For In You

•

3-5 years of direct and strong technical experience in BSA/AML investigations and operations in relevant financial crimes, transaction monitoring and investigation roles.

•

Demonstrated knowledge of BSA/AML, KYC regulations, risks and controls implementation globally.

•

Strong understanding of blockchain technology, cryptocurrency protocols, and decentralized networks.

•

Experience performing in a fast-paced environment and proven ability to meet deadlines.

•

Self-motivated, critical thinker and adept at working independently and in a dispersed team environment covering multiple and varied tasks.

•

Intuitive, highly ethical, and comfortable to question and challenge the status quo.

•

Strong communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written. Proficiency in writing detailed investigative reports and communicating complex technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

•

Experience working independently and with team members of all levels.

Nice to Haves

•

Prior experience working in a multi-national or matrix environment.

•

Familiarity with commonly used transaction monitoring & reporting tool(s), such as Solidus Labs, Chainalysis, or Elliptic.

•

Relevant certifications in blockchain technology, digital forensics, or financial crime investigations such as CAMS, CFCS are a plus.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

We are looking for a hands-on Content Lead with a strong writing and editing background to build content production processes across teams and bring consistency to our brand communications.
You’ll coordinate contributors, establish editorial standards, and create practical workflows from briefing to delivery. Alongside this, you’ll write and edit content yourself and use AI to improve production speed and quality.
You’ll work with content contributors across the business to build AI-assisted workflows and shape how content is produced. As the function develops, there is room to build a dedicated team and grow into a Head of Content role with broader ownership.

What You’ll Do
Content Coordination & Production

• Bring visibility and structure to content produced across marketing teams

• Align priorities, maintain a content backlog, and coordinate assignments

• Establish workflows for briefing, production, review, approval, and delivery.

• Work with Brand, Design, Product, Performance Marketing, Business Development, and CRM to clarify requests and agree on deliverables.

• Balance planned work with ad hoc requests and take ownership of delivery.

Brand Voice & Editorial Standards

• Develop and apply a consistent tone of voice across channels and formats.

• Create practical messaging guidelines, terminology, examples, and editorial checklists.

• Review contributors’ work for quality and consistency, and coordinate localisation to preserve meaning and tone.

Hands-on Writing & Editing

• Write, edit, and improve content across landing pages, campaigns, CRM communications, articles, and other marketing channels.

• Turn financial topics, product information, and business briefs into clear, accurate, and engaging content for the intended audience.

• Partner with the Head of Design to ensure copy and visuals work together.

• Work with Compliance and subject-matter experts to ensure accuracy and meet regulatory requirements while keeping content readable.

AI-Assisted Content Production

• Use AI for drafting, rewriting, editing, research support, and content adaptation.

• Build reusable prompts, reference materials, and workflows to make production faster and more consistent.

• Critically review AI output for facts, structure, tone, and relevance, recognising where specialist input or substantial rewriting is needed.

• Identify opportunities to automate routine tasks and scale content production.

Requirements

• A strong hands-on background in copywriting, editing, UX writing, or a related content role, supported by a portfolio.

• Experience writing or editing financial content and the ability to explain financial topics accurately to different audiences.

• Excellent written English and strong editorial judgement across tone, structure, clarity, and messaging.

• Experience coordinating content delivery, contributors, and stakeholders, with the ability to build processes where they are still developing.

• Practical experience using AI for professional content work and critically evaluating its output.

• Strong prioritisation skills and willingness to combine substantial writing and editing with coordination and process improvement.

Previous people-management experience or a formal Lead title is not required. This role can suit a strong senior copywriter or editor ready to take on broader ownership.

Nice to Have

• Experience in crypto, trading, brokerage, or investment-related content.

• Experience developing tone-of-voice guidelines, messaging frameworks, or editorial standards.

• Experience working with Design and Compliance or Legal teams.

• Experience with multilingual content and localisation.

• Experience coordinating freelancers or agencies.

• Experience building AI-assisted workflows, prompt libraries, or quality checks.

• Basic scripting or automation skills.

+
Please include a portfolio or relevant writing and editing samples with your application.
The process includes a recruiter conversation followed by an interview with the hiring manager, where we’ll discuss a few short practical cases together. We’ll ask you to review our products and selected landing pages beforehand. No take-home assignment is planned.

Company Description
Yuh - The most complete financial app of Switzerland.
Yuh is the app to pay, save and invest. Since 2021, the company is helping you manage your finances transparently, responsibly and in full freedom in this new post-banking era. Yuh is the brainchild of Swissquote, the Swiss leader in digital banking. With its solid reputation as well as our innovation to serve forward-thinkers, Yuh has it all.
Join the Yuhniverse
Do you enjoy helping people and want to gain hands-on experience in the banking and fintech world? Then this role is for you. As a Customer Care Representative, you will support our team in being the main link between Yuh and our clients. Our clients use our app to manage their finances and investments, and you will help ensure they have a smooth and positive experience.
You will answer their questions, solve their issues, and guide them through their financial journey while gaining valuable insights into customer care in a modern Swiss banking environment.

Job Description
Your mission
Do you love helping people and learning new things? If so, you might be the perfect fit for our Customer Care Representative position. You will be the main link between Yuh and our awesome clients, who use our app to manage their finances and investments. You will answer their questions, solve their problems, and guide them through their financial journey with Yuh.
Key Responsabilities
• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, handling of inbound and outbound phone calls (approximately 70–80% of daily activities), and delivering a consistently professional and positive customer experience.
• Provide accurate support via telephone, ensuring first class service quality. Resolving client inquiries, issues and requests related to the Yuh App in the sectors pay, save and investments.
• Actively guide and support clients, mainly over the phone, through their financial journey, explaining products, features and processes in a clear, empathetic, friendly and compliant manner.
• Ensure the highest levels of client satisfaction by executing client instructions and addressing concerns with friendliness and professionalism, especially in time sensitive or complex situations.
• Accurately document client interactions and outcomes in internal systems, ensuring proper follow-up and transparency across teams. Collaborate closely with other Customer Care Representatives and internal departments to ensure seamless service delivery and contribute insights for platform, service, and process improvements.
• Uphold the principles of fair client treatment, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance at all times.

Qualifications
• Completed apprenticeship (Federal certificate of Competence (Fähigkeitszeungnis / Fachausweis/ Berufsmatura)
• Previous experience in customer satisfaction, preferably in financial services in handling customer enquiries and complaints
• Fluency in English and German. For this position, Italian proficiency is highly recommended.
• A strong interest for financial product and markets, including stocks, ETFs and cryptocurrencies
• Excellent communication – verbal and written – skills
• Familiarity with office software and phone systems
• You are particularly skilled at listening, communicating, showing empathy, and being spersuasive
• You have a proactive and “can do” attitude
• You like working in a team

Unternehmensbeschreibung
Yuh – Die umfassendste Finanz-App der Schweiz.
Yuh ist die App zum Bezahlen, Sparen und Anlegen. Seit 2021 unterstützt das Unternehmen dich dabei, deine Finanzen in dieser neuen Ära nach dem klassischen Bankwesen transparent, verantwortungsbewusst und völlig frei zu verwalten. Yuh ist eine Entwicklung von Swissquote, dem Schweizer Marktführer im Bereich Digital Banking. Mit dem soliden Ruf und unserer Innovationskraft im Dienste zukunftsorientierter Menschen hat Yuh alles, was du brauchst.
Werde Teil des Yuhniverse
Macht es dir Spass, Menschen zu helfen, und möchtest du praktische Erfahrungen in der Banken- und Fintech-Branche sammeln? Dann ist diese Stelle genau das Richtige für dich. Als Mitarbeiter oder Mitarbeiterin im Kundenservice unterstützt du unser Team dabei, die wichtigste Schnittstelle zwischen Yuh und unseren Kunden zu sein. Unsere Kunden nutzen unsere App, um ihre Finanzen und Anlagen zu verwalten und du trägst dazu bei, dass sie dabei eine reibungslose und positive Erfahrung machen.
Du beantwortest ihre Fragen, löst ihre Probleme und begleitest sie auf ihrem finanziellen Weg, während du wertvolle Einblicke in die Kundenbetreuung in einem modernen Schweizer Bankumfeld gewinnst.

Stellenbeschreibung
Werde Teil unseres engagierten Customer Care Teams mit über 30 Mitarbeitenden in unserem modernen Customer Care Center in Dübendorf.
Als Client Service Representative bist du die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und trägst zu einem erstklassigen Kundenerlebnis im digitalen Banking bei. Mit einem umfassenden Onboarding und gezielten Schulungen bereiten wir dich optimal auf deine Aufgaben vor, ganz unabhängig davon, ob du bereits Erfahrung im Bankwesen oder im Kundenservice mitbringst.
Zu deinen täglichen Aufgaben gehören:
• Telefonische Kundenbetreuung, insbesondere zu Kontoeröffnungen und -schliessungen, Karten- und Zahlungsaufträgen sowie weiteren operativen Themen – inklusive vollständiger Dokumentation.
• Unterstützung bei Fragen zu unseren Produkten, Dienstleistungen und Tools sowie bei der Nutzung unserer digitalen Plattformen und technischen Anliegen.
• Bearbeitung von Kundenanliegen im Ticketsystem.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Business Operations, IT, Sales, Legal & Compliance und Marketing zur effizienten Lösung von Kundenanliegen.
• Erkennen und Melden verdächtiger Aktivitäten gemäss internen Richtlinien und Prozessen.

The Prediction Markets Operations team turns real-world events into clearly defined event contracts. We support markets across their full lifecycle—from an initial idea, through configuration and launch, into live operations, and finally to accurate resolution. Our work sits at the intersection of current events, marketplaces, and regulated products, and it demands precision at every step.

The team is responsible for making sure every contract is: clearly and objectively written, based on reliable, authoritative resolution sources, accurately configured, supported with appropriate images and content, thoroughly reviewed before launch, monitored while live, and resolved accurately and consistently.

The Role: Prediction Markets Operations Intern

This is a detail-oriented, hands-on internship for someone interested in marketplaces, operations, current events, financial technology, or regulated products. You will perform time-sensitive operational work and learn firsthand how prediction markets move from an idea to a live and, ultimately, settled contract.

Success in this role depends on accuracy, sound judgment, reliability, and operational discipline. Just as important is the willingness to escalate uncertainty rather than guess. You will support, coordinate, research, prepare, review, and execute work under established procedures, working closely with partners across Prediction Markets, Operations, Customer Support, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Design, Marketing, and our liquidity partners.

This will be a semester long internship program with 3 days a week in person at our New York City, NY office from January to April 2027.

Responsibilities:

Contract Research and Market Listings

• Research potential prediction-market contract ideas.

• Help turn ideas into precise, objective binary questions.

• Identify reliable and authoritative public resolution sources.

• Flag ambiguity, potentially prohibited subject matter, or questions requiring Compliance or Legal review.

• Prepare contract specifications, including outcomes, dates, descriptions, tickers, resolution criteria, and other listing details.

• Create and configure event contracts in the Contract Management System, or assist with structured CSV uploads, under established procedures.

• Support research and documentation related to product requirements and filings.

Quality Assurance and Launch Operations

• Perform pre-launch and post-upload quality assurance.

• Verify contract names, outcomes, ordering, start times, expiration times, resolution criteria, and designated sources.

• Review dates and times carefully, including UTC-based fields.

• Compare contracts with relevant external prediction markets when appropriate, and identify unintended differences in outcomes, timing, or mechanics.

• Confirm that event and social images are present and appropriate.

• Upload or update approved event images, social images, and display settings.

• Coordinate launch information with internal stakeholders and liquidity partners.

• Identify discrepancies and escalate issues before launch.

Customer and Live-Market Support

• Review, triage, and investigate prediction-market support tickets.

• Gather relevant facts, document findings, and route issues appropriately.

• Monitor live markets for incorrect content, timing discrepancies, operational issues, or unexpected behavior.

• Follow established incident-escalation procedures when urgent technical or operational issues arise.

• Maintain accurate trackers, checklists, SOPs, and internal documentation.

• Identify opportunities to improve repetitive workflows and reduce manual work.

Market Monitoring and Resolution

• Monitor contracts approaching expiration or awaiting resolution.

• Research outcomes using the contract’s designated resolution source.

• Prepare a proposed outcome, source links, and a concise rationale for internal review.

• Double-check resolution information against authoritative sources.

• Escalate unclear, conflicting, delayed, or incomplete source information rather than guessing.

• Execute approved market settlements in the Contract Management System after required training, review, and approval.

• Settlement activity is performed only under established procedures, supervision, access controls, and approval requirements. Accuracy is critical, because completed settlements may not be reversible.

• Document completed resolutions according to team procedures.

• Participate in a scheduled rotation for brief evening or weekend monitoring.

• This is lightweight, scheduled coverage—not continuous or unrestricted on-call work.

• Interns will primarily identify and escalate issues to the appropriate full-time team.

• Exceptional attention to detail.

• Strong written communication.

• Ability to research information and distinguish authoritative sources from unreliable ones.

• Sound judgment and a willingness to escalate uncertainty.

• Comfort with detailed, repeatable, process-driven tasks.

• Ability to manage time-sensitive work without sacrificing accuracy.

• Dependability and follow-through.

• Basic proficiency with spreadsheets and web-based business tools.

• Ability to work in-office.

• Availability for the scheduled, lightweight evening or weekend monitoring rotation.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Internship, academic, or project experience in operations, customer support, research, quality assurance, content operations, marketplaces, fintech, or another detail-oriented environment.

• Familiarity with prediction markets, financial markets, sports, politics, economics, or major current events.

• Experience with ticketing platforms, content-management systems, administrative tools, dashboards, or structured data entry.

• Interest in regulated products or operational risk.

• Experience creating or maintaining process documentation.

• Comfort learning unfamiliar internal tools quick.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Manager, Pro Trading & Derivatives Communications

 - The Manager of Pro Trading, Institutional & Derivatives Communications will inspire and support the team responsible for building and executing communications programs in support of Payward’s product strategy and Kraken's products and services targeted at professional traders, derivatives users and institutions globally.

 - Develop and execute an integrated external communications strategy aligned to Kraken's key business goals aimed at advancing the company's brand with key stakeholders across the pro trading, derivatives and institutional segments.

 - Develop strategies that expand Kraken's thought leadership positioning across professional and institutional client segments and work with the team in executing and expanding reach to new audiences through unique approaches to storytelling around trading products, risk management, and market infrastructure.

 - Develop and expand Kraken's bench of spokespeople in pro trading and derivatives, including building out key strategic messaging at the executive, product and segment level that resonates with traders, fund managers and institutional decision-makers.

 - Prepare communications materials including company announcements, talking points, media statements, speaker submissions, pitches and briefing materials tailored to professional and institutional audiences.

 - Build connectivity with multiple stakeholders including institutional partners, trading desks, market data providers, the communications team and key external agencies serving the pro/institutional space.

 - Bring social media first thinking to media relations and content, with particular attention to platforms and channels where professional traders and institutions gather.

 - Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Bachelor’s degree required along with 7+ years of proven experience leading and executing communications programs and initiatives, crypto experience preferred.

 - Highly proactive, determined and results driven.

 - Outstanding writing, editing and communications strategy skills. A hands on contributor with an ability to translate complex topics and capture the views and voices of senior leaders.

 - Experience working with a geographically dispersed workforce and managing complex communications challenges.

 - Experience working directly with executives to enhance executive presence, deliver strong messaging and improve presentation/interview skills.

 - A team player with a track record of success delivering high quality work in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

 - Experience leading, mentoring and scaling communications teams

 - Knowledgeable and passionate about the crypto industry

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About The Opportunity

OKX is building out its equities and tokenized securities business. This is a post-trade and brokerage systems product role — you will own the layer that sits between our users and the securities markets: order management, execution, settlement, asset servicing and reconciliation.

We have strong crypto product and engineering talent. What this role brings is depth in brokerage architecture and securities market structure: how these systems are built, why they are built that way, and what breaks at scale. You will be the internal authority on that, and your judgment will shape decisions that are expensive to reverse.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Own the brokerage core — order management, execution and routing, instrument lifecycle and trading status, settlement and reconciliation.

•

Shape account, custody and clearing architecture, along with the operating model required to run it.

•

Own corporate actions and asset servicing end to end, in both conventional and on-chain form.

•

Define how securities risk and margin frameworks coexist with those of a 24/7 digital asset market.

•

Bring market structure, execution quality and regulatory requirements into product decisions early, before they become blockers.

•

Set the standard for rigour — write PRDs precise enough to build from, and lead alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury.

What We Look For In You

Domain Depth

•

5+ years in post-trade or brokerage systems product management. We strongly prefer candidates from internet and licensed brokerages — Futu, Tiger, Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, Webull, Longbridge — as well as clearing firms and brokerage infrastructure providers.

•

Architectural perspective. You have a clear view of where responsibility belongs across the order, execution, clearing, settlement, asset servicing and ledger layers, and of what goes wrong downstream when a boundary is drawn in the wrong place.

•

Depth across the order and execution path. Order types and parameters, state machine design, idempotency across an external execution boundary, cancel/replace and partial-fill semantics, timeout and exception recovery. This is the core craft of the role.

•

End-to-end ownership of at least one area beyond the order path — clearing and settlement, corporate actions and asset servicing, margin and risk, securities lending, or position and cash reconciliation.

•

Commercial and historical perspective. You understand how a brokerage actually earns, how each revenue line constrains the systems beneath it, and why the industry made the structural choices it did.

Ways of Working

•

Strong technical intuition. You are comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers. You do not need to be a developer, but you think with the rigour of one.

•

You design for the exceptions — the halted symbol, the timed-out counterparty, the partial fill, the corporate action mid-flight — not just the order that goes through.

•

You run programs, not just write specs. You produce rigorous PRDs independently, drive alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury, and own the full lifecycle from requirements through post-launch review.

•

You write precisely, and can make complex mechanics legible to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

•

High agency. You are comfortable taking an open question all the way to a shipped, reconciled system, and making calls with incomplete information.

•

Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R&D center.

Nice-To-Haves

•

Product experience with margin financing or securities lending.

•

Exposure to tokenized securities, digital asset custody, or on-chain settlement.

•

Experience integrating with broker-dealer or clearing APIs, as either the integrator or the provider.

•

Hands-on experience with multi-jurisdiction regulatory frameworks — SEC/FINRA, MiFID II, or equivalent.

•

A track record of launching a brokerage product in a new market from zero.

•

Fluency in English to support communication with global product and business stakeholders.

•

Genuine curiosity about what happens when securities markets meet 24/7 markets.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

• L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

• Wellness and meal allowances

• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a highly motivated Technology and Security Risk Manager within the Second Line of Defence (2LOD). You will be responsible for continuously refining and scaling the Technology and Security oversight program, guiding first-line of defence (1LOD) execution, and providing independent risk challenge.

You will be a key member of OKX's Risk team, helping to shape and scale the firm’s 2LOD Security & Data Risk programs. You’ll work closely with stakeholders including Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit.

You will play a key role in developing and implementing a comprehensive Technology and Security Risk Management program. This includes 2LOD oversight of technology defects, issues, and incidents, Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), key risk indicators (KRIs) and reporting.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Technology Risk (including Technology Resilience, Change Management, SDLC, CI/CD pipeline, and software quality assurance) and Cybersecurity (covering internal and external threat vectors, control weaknesses, and organisational cyber hygiene). We are looking for a candidate with a strong drive for improvement and career growth.

What You’ll Be Doing

Collaborate with internal stakeholders across the company to proactively identify, escalate, assess, and mitigate Technology and Security risks, ensuring adherence to the Technology Risk Policy.

Providing oversight of Technology and Security Risk incidents and issues, and partnering with 1LOD stakeholders to enhance related processes and ensure effective oversight

Lead the Technology Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) process from a 2LOD perspective, ensuring adherence to the ERM RCSA methodology, and providing effective challenge and oversight of 1LOD Security risks and controls.

Support the Security Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) definition, monitoring, and reporting.

Supporting the implementation and ongoing enhancement of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) systems to enable effective risk oversight

Advocate and support the implementation of Risk Management frameworks for technology stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor for the first line.

Stay up to date on emerging trends and regulations in the digital asset space, proactively identifying and addressing new risk considerations.

What We Look For In You

•

8+ years in information security, with a strong security architecture or technical security background; fintech, crypto or cloud-native experience preferred.

•

Practical experience designing, implementing or reviewing cloud, IAM, cryptographic, network or application security controls.

•

Experience in risk oversight, or readiness to transition, with the technical judgement to challenge controls and recommend proportionate improvements.

•

Ability to threat-model systems and assess technical evidence, including architecture diagrams, IAM policies, logging configurations and dependencies.

•

Working knowledge of cloud resilience, multi-region/AZ failover, RTO/RPO and disaster recovery testing.

•

Familiarity with NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and relevant privacy requirements, including GDPR and PDPA, and their application to technical controls.

•

Ability to independently assess and test controls, evaluate incidents and drive remediation with engineering and security teams; GRC platform experience desirable.

•

Clear written and verbal communication, translating technical findings into prioritised actions for business stakeholders and governance committees.

•

Strong stakeholder management skills, providing constructive challenge and collaborating across functions and geographies.

•

A proactive, adaptable approach, with confidence taking ownership and improving practices in a fast-paced environment.

•

A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience; CISSP, CCSP, cloud security/architecture, CISA or CISM qualifications desirable.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

We are at an inflection point where AI is fundamentally reshaping what products can do and how users experience them. We're not just looking for a product manager — we're looking for a hybrid product builder who truly understands AI capabilities and can translate technical potential into real user value.

You will lead end-to-end product design for LLM / Agent-powered applications — from zero to one — across domains including intelligent customer service, personalized recommendations, AI assistants, and automated workflows. You are the critical connector between user insights, AI technical capabilities, and business objectives: someone who can discuss RAG retrieval strategies and multi-agent orchestration with ML engineers, while clearly articulating product value and delivery roadmaps to business stakeholders.

If you have genuine passion for AI-native products and the ability to define clear product direction amid ambiguity and rapid change, we'd love to build the next generation of AI applications together.

Key Responsibilities

•

End-to-End AI Product Lifecycle Management: Own the full product lifecycle of AI applications — including intelligent chatbots, AI assistants, recommendation systems, and automated workflows — from requirements definition and product design through to launch and delivery. Produce high-quality PRDs, interaction flow diagrams, and acceptance criteria while driving cross-functional teams to execute efficiently.

•

LLM / Agent Capability Productization: Deeply engage in Agent product design, including task planning workflows, tool-calling strategies (Function Calling / MCP), context management mechanisms, multi-agent orchestration logic, and graceful failure/fallback handling. Translate underlying model capabilities into meaningful, perceivable user value.

•

AI Evaluation Framework & Quality Standards: Build Harness evaluation frameworks for AI products — designing test scenario sets, evaluation metric systems (accuracy, hallucination rate, task completion rate, etc.), and regression test case libraries. Independently assess AI capability boundaries and drive continuous model iteration and product quality improvement.

•

Conversational Product Design & Knowledge Engineering: Lead platform architecture planning for intelligent customer service and conversational assistant products, covering knowledge base structure design, dialogue flow and SOP design, corpus annotation and training strategy, intelligent reply generation, and case summarization. Leverage large-scale data analysis to continuously optimize conversation quality and issue resolution rates.

•

Personalization Engines & Generative UI Products: Collaborate deeply with ML and data teams to design recommendation strategies that deliver truly personalized, individualized user experiences. Define generative UI product requirements and drive growth in core business metrics including CTR, conversion rate, and user retention. Establish comprehensive attribution analysis frameworks for recommendation effectiveness.

•

AI Capability Integration with Business Scenarios: Develop a thorough understanding of business goals and user pain points. Proactively identify opportunities to apply AI technologies — including RAG, Prompt Engineering, and multimodal capabilities — to concrete use cases. Define clear product evolution roadmaps that balance technical feasibility, user experience, and commercial value.

•

Cross-Functional Collaboration & AI-Native Product Culture: Act as the product Owner in close collaboration with algorithm, engineering, data, design, operations, and business teams. Maintain a strong sense of ownership in a fast-moving AI-native environment, continuously track industry developments, and rapidly translate emerging AI capabilities into product innovation opportunities.

Requirements

•

Product Experience: 3+ years of product management experience, with at least 1 year of direct hands-on experience delivering AI application products, AIGC products, or Agent products. Must have fully shipped at least one AI-related feature module or standalone product.

•

AI Technical Understanding: Deep understanding of the productization of mainstream AI technologies, including but not limited to: LLM Prompt Engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture, Agent fundamentals (tool calling / task planning / context window management), and conversational system design. Ability to independently evaluate the product feasibility of technical proposals.

•

Evaluation & Data Capabilities: Proven ability to design AI product evaluation frameworks — independently defining evaluation metrics, building test case sets, and tracking product performance through data analysis. Familiarity with A/B experiment design and a strong data-driven decision-making mindset.

•

Documentation & Communication Skills: Ability to write structured, logically rigorous PRDs, technical requirement documents, and flow diagrams. Excellent cross-functional communication skills with the ability to accurately bridge information between technical and business teams, eliminating information gaps.

•

User Insight & Product Thinking: Sharp ability to translate ambiguous user needs into clearly defined product requirements. Skilled at finding the right product balance between AI capability boundaries and user expectations — avoiding both overpromising and underutilizing model capabilities.

•

Learning Agility & Ownership Mindset: Sustained enthusiasm and capacity for continuous learning in a rapidly evolving AI landscape. Strong sense of ownership — able to proactively define problems, drive decisions, and take accountability for outcomes in highly ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

•

Familiarity with cutting-edge AI engineering practices including MCP (Model Context Protocol), Function Calling, and multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain / AutoGen / CrewAI), enabling deep technical dialogue with engineering teams.

•

Experience with AI Harness / Eval / Benchmark platform product design or usage, with involvement in establishing and maintaining LLM evaluation systems.

•

Background in Fintech / e-commerce / SaaS industries, with an understanding of the unique product design requirements for AI in high-concurrency, compliance-sensitive environments.

•

Bilingual fluency in Chinese and English (spoken and written), with the ability to independently drive product collaboration and cross-cultural communication within international teams.

We are a global payments and digital asset exchange business. As Head of Trading, you will own our FX strategy, market making strategy and the Philippines OTC/FX trading team. FX Strategy

• Define and execute the FX trading strategy across our payment corridors and currency pairs, with a focus on PHP and other emerging-market currencies.

• Manage pricing, spreads and execution quality for cross-border flows. Source liquidity from banks, LPs and other counterparties.

• Work with Treasury on hedging and exposure management, so that trading and balance-sheet risk are managed together.

Market Making Strategy

• Design, run and continuously improve our market making strategy for exchange order books, including quoting, inventory management, spread and risk parameters.

Philippines OTC / FX Trading Team

• Grow OTC volumes and client relationships in coordination with Sales and Business teams.

• Establish and enforce trading risk frameworks: position limits, stop-loss, VaR, counterparty and concentration limits.

• Produce regular reports on PnL, exposure, volumes, spread capture and desk KPIs for senior leadership. Support audits and regulatory inquiries.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Support new market entries and product launches from a pricing, liquidity and trading perspective.
